_comment: Everything the first run downloads, pinned in one place. Bump deliberately, then rebuild the fat artifacts so thin and fat stay identical.
_scannerUnsupported_comment: Platforms where the on-device scanner cannot be installed at all, so io does not try. torch has shipped no macOS x86_64 wheel since 2.2.2, and transformers needs a newer torch than that, so there is no combination that works on an Intel Mac. Those machines install only what is needed to read files, and io offers a privacy server or pattern matching instead.
_scannerPackages_comment: The packages that exist only to run the scanner. Skipped on the platforms above.
